title: glandulifolia fragrans
intro: Glandulifolia fragrans, commonly known as the "Sweet Gale", is a species of plant in the cinnamomum genus. This plant is known for its fragrant leaves and stems, which are rich in bioactive compounds with various health benefits. The health benefits of Glandulifolia fragrans include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, terpenes, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
